en.headline: Star Ferry Car Park to cease operations and be demolished after new site opens
en.dek: The Transport Department said the multi-storey car park on Edinburgh Place will close once public parking spaces at Central Site 3 enter service, with monthly rentals shifting from January.
body: The Star Ferry Car Park in Central will stop operating and be demolished once public parking spaces at the new Central Harbourfront Site 3 come into service, the Transport Department announced.

The car park, which has stood on Edinburgh Place since 1957 as Hong Kong's first multi-storey facility, currently offers about 370 spaces across three levels. Its quarterly rental places will switch to monthly sales from January next year, with applications open from Friday to 4 December. From February, only hourly parking will be available.
The department said the change supports the development of Central Site 3. The existing structure has overlooked Victoria Harbour for decades and sits near the Star Ferry pier and City Hall.
Details of the new public parking at Site 3 were not specified in the announcement, but the car park's closure is tied directly to the opening of those spaces.

zh.headline: 天星碼頭停車場將於新海濱泊車位啟用後停止營運並拆卸
zh.dek: 運輸署表示，中環愛丁堡廣場的天星碼頭停車場待三號用地公眾泊車位投入服務後便會關閉拆卸，明年一月起季租改為月租。
body: 運輸署公布，為配合中環新海濱三號用地發展，位於中環愛丁堡廣場的天星碼頭停車場將於三號用地公眾泊車位啟用後停止營運並拆卸。
該停車場自1957年落成，是全港首個多層停車場，分為三層，約有370個車位。以往的季租泊車名額將於明年1月改為月租方式銷售，申請期由本周五起至12月4日。由2月起，所有泊車位只提供時租安排。
署方指有關安排是為配合三號用地發展。停車場長年坐落維港海濱，鄰近天星小輪碼頭及香港大會堂。
公告未詳細說明三號用地新泊車位的規模，但停車場關閉時間直接繫於該等泊車位投入服務。
